## Part 1

goal: code in row 2981, column 3075.


 Multiply it by 252533 to get 5088824049625. Then, divide that by 33554393 -> remainder



 ```{r}
 calc_code <- function(i) {
   (i * 252533) %% 33554393
 }
 calc_code(20151125)

 s <- 20151125
 for (i in 1:10) {
   s <- calc_code(s)
   print(s)
 }
```

row = 2981, col = 3075

```{r}
#matrix(data = 0, nrow = 2981, ncol = 3075)

goal <- 6100

m <- matrix(data = 0, nrow = goal, ncol = goal)
s <- 20151125

for (g in 1:goal) {
  iv <- g:1
  jv <- 1:g
  for (i in seq_along(iv)) {
    m[iv[i], jv[i]] <- s
    s <- calc_code(s)
  }
}
m
```
